references.text: Jesus gives a similar instruction not to tell anyone about the vision until he has risen from the dead, after the transfiguration on the mountain.
After Jesus' transfiguration on the mountain, when they came down, he also gave them instructions not to tell what they had seen until after his resurrection.
Herod hears about Jesus' fame and wonders if he is John the Baptist raised from the dead, which reflects the theme of resurrection.
